findings.text: Typesafe test record combines liveness control and payload: payload held in two unsigned values, accompanied by a reference counter, a spin protector, and a sequence protector supporting three alternative validation flavors.

Four per-CPU counter flavors each perform a balanced increment then decrement of the calling CPU location over the requested count; flavors differ only in exclusion around the update, respectively no exclusion, preemption exclusion, bottom-half exclusion, and interrupt-state-saving exclusion, with delay forms inserting a caller-controlled pause between the two updates.

Read-write test primitives initialize once and report success, then each iteration acquires read-side hold and releases it, with delay forms holding across a pause; raw spin variants instead hold preemption exclusion across the whole loop and acquire then release the central test lock per iteration, optionally preserving interrupt state.

Acquire-release flavor runs under preemption exclusion and per iteration publishes an increasing value to the calling CPU location using ordered load then ordered store, with the delay form pausing between load and store.

Scheduler-clock, fast-realtime-clock and jiffies flavors each accumulate successive readings of their respective time source across the requested count under preemption exclusion and publish the sum to a shared volatile sink so the loop is not discarded; delay forms pause after each accumulation.

Bare disable-enable flavors measure primitive cost without data access: preemption flavor nests preemption exclusion inside migration exclusion, bottom-half and interrupt flavors nest their respective disable-enable pair inside preemption exclusion, and interrupt-save flavor preserves flags; delay forms pause while disabled.

Each measurement flavor is described by a common operations record binding an optional initializer and cleanup, a plain iteration routine, a delay-aware iteration routine, a short textual label, and for bottom-half flavors a flag requesting interrupts stay enabled during timing; labels cover per-CPU, lock, clock, preemption, interrupt and typesafe families.

Typesafe read path selects a random array slot, enters RCU read-side protection, observes the version field, attempts flavor-specific acquisition, revalidates the version, optionally delays, re-reads and releases, retrying from RCU entry on acquisition failure, version change, or release-reported conflict, and warns on torn version or inconsistent payload relation after exit.

Three acquisition flavors share a boolean acquire-release function pair: reference flavor conditionally elevates the counter and frees on last drop, spin flavor unconditionally locks and unlocks, sequence flavor samples a start token and reports validation outcome on release.

Typesafe record permits three mutually exclusive read-side exclusion choices: reference-count pinning with reclamation on last put, spin mutual exclusion, or optimistic sequence validation with retry; all operate under outer RCU read-side protection during slot lookup and version checks.

Typesafe fixture creates a typesafe-by-RCU slab cache with a constructor initializing locks and randomizing the version field, sizes and populates a pointer array with singly-referenced entries whose second payload is the square of the first, selects the acquire-release pair by active operations record, and on teardown frees entries, releases array and cache, and clears the function pointers.

Reader thread affinitizes to its assigned CPU, announces readiness, waits for experiment start or stop request, performs warmup with barrier synchronization, executes one timed iteration with interrupts suppressed unless the flavor opts into enabled interrupts, records non-negative duration, participates in cooldown synchronization, and signals completion when last to finish, repeating until stopped.

Experiment control dispatches either plain or delay-aware iteration based on configured read delay, repeats dispatch until a jiffies deadline for warm-cool phases with voluntary rescheduling, and aggregates per-reader durations into a total while emitting chunked batched log lines keyed by experiment index.

Balanced pairing is required: preemption, migration, bottom-half, interrupt, lock, and RCU protections must each be exited on every path including retries; typesafe path must not use the slot after failed acquisition and must hold RCU across acquisition and validation to avoid use-after-free.
